assume.base: Daily sales hold steady around the average you entered, and the supplier delivers in the same lead time every time.
assume.order: You order as soon as stock falls to the reorder point, and you check stock every day.

assume.service: Safety stock = z × standard deviation of daily sales × square root of the lead time, assuming daily sales are roughly normally distributed and z = {z} for a {sl}% service level.
assume.qty: Suggested quantity = daily sales × order cycle. It is not a minimum order and ignores supplier terms and discounts.
assume.round: Figures are rounded up to a whole unit.
